Sub: Intimation of resignation of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director of the Company 
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India 
(Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI Listing Regulations), 
this is to inform you that, Mr. Harish Bhat (DIN: 00478198), Non-Executive Non-Independent 
Director of the Company has tendered his resignation with effect from 17th October 2026, due to 
his existing and growing professional and personal commitments. 
 
The details as required under Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations read with SEBI Master 
Circular dated 30th January 2026 along with the resignation letter are annexed herewith. 
 
A copy of this intimation would be available on the website of the Company at 
www.trentlimited.com  
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thank you. 
 
For Trent Limited

Dear Sir,
Subject : Resignation from the Board of Directors of Trent Ltd.
I am writing this letter to communicate my decision to resign from the Board of Directors 
of Trent Ltd., due to my existing and growing professional and personal commitments.
May I request you to please treat this letter as my resignation. I request your kind 
acceptance of the same.
It has been a pleasure and privilege to serve on the Board of Trent Ltd. for the past 
several years, and to participate actively in the deliberations of the Board. I have 
greatly admired your leadership, which has been instrumental in the rapid growth and 
transformation of the Company.
Thank you very much for the opportunity that the Board and you have provided me, to 
contribute to the governance and strategic directions of the Company.
May I take this opportunity, Sir, to wish Trent great and continued success in the years 
ahead.
(Harish Bhat)
